patches.notes:
**Bokan Densetsu - Buta mo Odaterya Doronboo** is a 2000 WonderSwan game by Banpresto starring the Doronbo Gang from Tatsunoko's Time Bokan series: Doronjo, Boyacky and Tonzura. It was released only in Japan.

Their boss Dokurobei sends them through time and space after the T-Parts, the keys to the Earth-Buyer Gold. Each chapter parodies a Time Bokan show (Time Bokan, Yatterman, Zenderman, Otasukeman, Yattodetaman, Ippatsuman, Itadakiman). The trio runs a crooked business to raise funds, builds and customizes a mecha, explores, and battles the heroes' robots, until the inevitable punishment.

> **Please read:** this translation was made **entirely with AI**, as a personal project. It is shared as it is for anyone who wants to play, but it must **never be uploaded to romhacking sites** (romhacking.net and the like). It isn't up to the standard of a real fan translation and doesn't belong there.

**How to patch**

Apply the .bps to *Time Bokan Series - Bokan Densetsu - Buta mo Odaterya Doronboo (Japan).ws* (1 MB, CRC32 7DA6ACB9) with Floating IPS, beat or ROM Patcher JS. The result is 2 MB, CRC32 D4C0A5C5; keep the .ws extension.

With Floating IPS on the command line:

    flips --apply "Time Bokan Series - Bokan Densetsu - Buta mo Odaterya Doronboo (EN v0.9).bps" "Time Bokan Series - Bokan Densetsu - Buta mo Odaterya Doronboo (Japan).ws" "Time Bokan Series - Bokan Densetsu - Buta mo Odaterya Doronboo (EN v0.9).ws"

You must provide your own copy of the original Japanese game …
